label: Genlock Style — Look & Consistency
description: A reusable visual-style modifier: look, color palette, grain, references, per-provider style codes, and negative prompts. Attaches at project/scene/shot level and feeds the generator bones' style/negative — it does not render on its own.

look.label: Look
look.description: Overall visual look in one phrase, e.g. 'film-noir cinematic, high contrast, modern tech polish'.

references.label: References
references.description: Reference titles or visual touchstones, e.g. ["Blade Runner 2049", "neo-noir tech interiors"].

grain.label: Grain / Texture
grain.description: Film grain / texture note, e.g. 'subtle 35mm film grain'.

color_palette.label: Color Palette
color_palette.description: Palette descriptors, e.g. ["jet black", "tungsten amber", "cyan studio glow"].

mood.label: Mood
mood.description: Target mood: mysterious / tense / dramatic / ominous.

technical.label: Technical
technical.description: Technical keywords, e.g. ["shallow depth of field", "cinematic composition"].

negative_prompt.label: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.description: Shared negative keywords applied across generators.

style_codes.label: Provider Style Codes
style_codes.description: Optional per-provider raw codes, e.g. { "midjourney": "--style raw --stylize 750", "runway": { "style_preset": "cinematic_realism" } }.

motion_style.label: Motion Style
motion_style.description: Movement grammar, e.g. 'slow push-ins, no whip pans, 24fps cadence'.

grading_lut.label: Grading LUT
grading_lut.description: Path to a .cube LUT this look bakes with (Safelight applies explicitly — never auto).

reference_image.label: Style Reference Image
reference_image.description: Optional reference image for style transfer.

defaults.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, bright flat lighting, low quality, overexposed, watermark, text on screen

v_setup_injection.note: Style is a modifier: it contributes look/palette/grain to the generator bone's prompt and shares its negative_prompt. It is not a standalone render.

llm_instructions.writing_guide: Author one shared style and reuse it verbatim across every shot in a sequence so the look stays consistent. Set it at the metadata (project) level for a whole episode, override at scene level for a distinct location/act, and only at shot level for a deliberate one-off. The style feeds the image/video generator bones' style/look fields and contributes its negative_prompt — do not restate the subject or action here.

field_guides.look: One fluent phrase capturing the whole visual signature.
field_guides.references: Concrete touchstones the model recognizes (films, photographers, looks).
field_guides.color_palette: 3–4 concrete color names that recur across the sequence.
field_guides.primary_style: Few core keywords; keep identical across shots in a sequence.
field_guides.style_codes: Raw provider flags/presets passed through untouched when that provider runs.
field_guides.negative_prompt: Comma-separated; merged with the generator bone's own negatives.

do: Define the style once and reuse it across the sequence
Set project-level default at metadata, override sparingly per scene
Keep palette and primary_style identical across continuous shots
dont: Restate subject or action in the style bone
Change core style keywords shot-to-shot within one continuous sequence
Treat this as a generator — it has no render output of its own
